d: Bihar ke shahri ilakon men agar aap naya makan banane ki taiyari kar rahe hain ya apne ghar ka naksha pas karane vale hain to bhavan nirman se jure nae niymon ko janna aapke lie jaruri hai. rajy sarkar ne makan nirman ke alag-alag hisson ke lie nyuntam aakar nirdharit kar diya hai. ab bedrum, living rum, kichan, stor rum, bathrum aur shauchalay banane ke lie tay mankon ka palan karna hoga. yani makan banvate samay sirph jamin ki uplabdhata aur apni jarurat ke hisab se kamron ka nirman nahin karaya ja sakega, balki unke aakar aur chhat ki oonchaee ka bhi dhyan rakhna hoga.
